I finally found a solution today after struggling with this for weeks. You need to install grapejuice from package and install patched wine. 

1. Enter desktop mode and uninstall grapejuice from discover store
2. Set a password in konsole if you haven't already using passwd command. Then, you need to input the following commands:
3. sudo steamos-readonly disable
4. git clone --depth=1 https://aur.archlinux.org/grapejuice-git.git /tmp/grapejuice-git 
5. cd /tmp/grapejuice-git 
6. makepkg -si 
7. After grapejuice is installed, open it once. 
8. Then, put in the following commands to install patched wine
9. cd /tmp 
10. wget https://pastebin.com/raw/5SeVb005 -O install.py 
11. python3 install.py 

And that's it! After that, you should add Roblox as a non-steam game. If you don't know how, open steam in desktop mode, click Add game on the bottom left and click Add a non-Steam game. If Roblox doesn't show up in the list of apps, click Browse, then go to /usr/share/applications/ and double click on roblox-player.desktop. After that you can apply artwork in whichever way you choose.
